title: Dark Mode Can Wait

pre.en: What did people ask for most in the beta survey?
pre.zh: 测试版问卷里，大家最想要的是什么？
options: A way to turn off notifications

intro: 一段对话：合租家务 App「Rota」三周后上线，产品经理 Hannah 列了十二个功能，团队只做得完四个。她想先做分享，Chen 想先修离线同步，两个人一来一回地讨价还价。读的时候留意 so that：「做这件事，好让谁能怎样」，后面常跟 can、could。

sentences.en: Right, it's Tuesday the thirteenth, and Rota goes live in three weeks.
sentences.zh: 好，今天是 13 号星期二，Rota 三周后上线。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: I've had this list of twelve features since July, and Arjun says we can only build four.
sentences.zh: 这张十二个功能的清单我从七月就开始列了，Arjun 说我们只做得完四个。

sentences.en: Four if nobody gets ill.
sentences.zh: 还得没人生病，才做得完四个。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: What's at the top?
sentences.zh: 排第一的是什么？

sentences.en: Social sharing.
sentences.zh: 社交分享。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: We need it so that users can invite their flatmates from day one.
sentences.zh: 有了它，用户从第一天起就能把室友拉进来。

sentences.en: Our investors have taken a real interest in it, too, so dark mode can wait.
sentences.zh: 投资人对这个也特别感兴趣，所以深色模式可以往后放。

sentences.en: Sorry, but I'm going to push back on that.
sentences.zh: 不好意思，这一点我不同意。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: Right now, sync doesn't work offline.
sentences.zh: 现在没网的时候，同步是用不了的。

sentences.en: If you tick off a chore on the Tube, it just disappears.
sentences.zh: 你在地铁上勾掉一项家务，它直接就没了。

sentences.en: I'd rather fix that first, so that nobody loses their list underground.
sentences.zh: 我宁可先把这个修好，这样谁也不会在地铁里把清单弄丢。

sentences.en: Go easy on me, Chen.
sentences.zh: 手下留情啊，小陈。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: We're on a budget, and I can't hire anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我们预算紧，我没法再招人了。

sentences.en: If we'd started in July, we'd have had time for all twelve.
sentences.zh: 要是七月就开工，十二个都做得完。

sentences.en: Well, we didn't, so first things first.
sentences.zh: 可我们没有啊，所以先办最要紧的。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: If the app loses people's data, nobody will care how they share it.
sentences.zh: App 要是把大家的数据弄丢了，谁还在乎怎么分享。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 有道理。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: I've been too busy thinking about investors.
sentences.zh: 我光顾着想投资人了。

sentences.en: Maybe I've lost touch with what users actually want.
sentences.zh: 说不定我已经不太清楚用户真正想要什么了。

sentences.en: I'm just popping out for a coffee and a think.
sentences.zh: 我出去买杯咖啡，顺便想一想。

sentences.en: Take your time.
sentences.zh: 不着急。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'll try Arjun again, but he isn't answering.
sentences.zh: 我再联系一下 Arjun，不过他一直没回。

sentences.en: OK, I've come up with a plan.
sentences.zh: 好，我想了个办法。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Sync first, and sharing in December.
sentences.zh: 先做同步，分享放到十二月。

sentences.en: We'll make room for it in the first update, so that the investors can see it before Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我们在第一次更新里给它腾出位置，好让投资人圣诞节前能看到。

sentences.en: And what do you want from me in return?
sentences.zh: 那作为交换，你要我做什么？
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: A simple invite link, so people can at least add their flatmates.
sentences.zh: 一个简单的邀请链接，好让大家至少能把室友加进来。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: Could you have a go at it this week?
sentences.zh: 你这周能试着做一下吗？

sentences.en: Fine.
sentences.zh: 行。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I think we've just reached a compromise.
sentences.zh: 我看我们算是各让了一步。

sentences.en: That works for me.
sentences.zh: 我没意见。
sentences.speaker: Hannah

sentences.en: At the end of the day, it has to work.
sentences.zh: 说到底，东西得能用才行。

sentences.en: Sorry I'm late!
sentences.zh: 抱歉我来晚了！
sentences.speaker: Arjun

sentences.en: Have you seen the beta survey?
sentences.zh: 你们看测试版的问卷了吗？

sentences.en: The feature people asked for most is a button to turn off our notifications.
sentences.zh: 大家最想要的功能，是一个能把我们的通知关掉的按钮。

cards.note: 动词 invest in sth（投资）；名词 investment。
to start to be interested in something and want to learn about it
to disagree with an idea or a plan and argue against it
cards.tip: 职场常用，语气比 disagree 委婉，意思是「这一点我有不同看法」；名词 pushback（反对意见）。
cards.example: The team pushed back on the new deadline because it was too early.

cards.note: 这里当副词用：work offline；反义 online。
常用复数 chores；做家务是 do the chores。
to treat someone more gently than usual and not criticise them too much
cards.tip: 常用在祈使句里；go easy on sth 还可以是「少吃点、少用点」：go easy on the salt。
cards.example: Go easy on the new guy — it's only his second day.

cards.note: having only a limited amount of money to spend
英式 hire 还有「租用」：hire a car。

cards.zh: 先办最要紧的事；一件一件来
cards.note: something you say when you think the most important thing should be done before anything else
cards.tip: 固定说法，常放在句首，后面接要先做的事；things 用复数。
cards.example: First things first: has everyone got a coffee?

cards.note: to stop talking to or writing to someone, so that you no longer know what they are doing
cards.tip: touch 前面不加 the；反义是 keep in touch with。这里是夸张的玩笑：同事几天没回消息。
cards.example: I lost touch with most of my school friends after I moved.

cards.note: to leave a place for a short time
to do something slowly and carefully without hurrying
to think of an idea, a plan or an answer
cards.tip: 后面接 idea / plan / solution / name 这类词；不说 come up a plan，with 不能丢。
cards.example: We need to come up with a name for the new café.

cards.note: to move or remove things so that there is space for something else
to try to do something, often for the first time
cards.tip: 英式口语；试着做某事用 have a go at sth / at doing sth。
cards.example: I've never made bread, but I'd like to have a go.

cards.note: to agree on something after both sides accept less than they first wanted
cards.tip: 动词用 reach，也可以说 come to a compromise；compromise 读 /ˈkɒmprəmaɪz/。
cards.example: After an hour of talking, the two families reached a compromise.

cards.note: 也能当动词：We both had to compromise。
something you say to agree to a plan, a time or an idea
cards.tip: 约时间、定方案时很常用；问对方可以说 Does that work for you?
cards.example: "Shall we meet at ten?" "That works for me."

cards.text: at the end of the day
cards.note: used to say what is most important after you have thought about everything
cards.tip: 口语里很常用，不是「傍晚」的意思；正式写作里少用。
cards.example: At the end of the day, it's your money, so it's your choice.

cards.note: 名词重音在前 /ˈsɜːveɪ/；做调查是 do / carry out a survey。
动词 notify（通知）比较正式；关掉通知是 turn off notifications。
